top_signals.title: Short-Term Yields Rise on Warsh’s Inflation Pledge: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders sent short-dated bonds lower as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s vow to bring inflation to the 2% target bolstered bets on a rate hike this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Fed Chairman Warsh expresses concern about inflation, advocates for 'quieter' central bank
top_signals.summary: He used the speech to outline his philosophy on policymaking while carefully sidestepping any signals
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Warsh Says Inflation Isn’t Slowing, Vows to Reach 2% Target
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh warned inflation isn’t meaningfully slowing and said policymakers must be confident that it is, otherwise the central bank has “work to do.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed's Hammack Backs Rate Hike to Rein in Inflation
top_signals.summary: Interest Rates are "the clearest, most transparent, easiest-to-communicate tool that we have,” says Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammock, adding that there’s a long history showing the impact of interest rate moves on the economy. She spoke with Bloomberg's Tom Keene, Lisa Abramowicz and Michael McKee in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Land Rover Should Be Wary of Chinese Look-Alikes
top_signals.summary: Jaguar Land Rover should expect a lot more competition from Chinese automakers. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Chis Bryant explains how their manufacturing of huge SUVs and offroaders look very similar, but for a fraction of the price. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: El auge del oro impulsa la minería ilegal y la deforestación en la Amazonía de Perú
top_signals.summary: En una remota selva al sur de la Amazonía peruana, las minas de oro se han extendido sin control, lo que ha impulsado una de las economías ilícitas más grandes de Sudamérica. (Source: Bloomberg)
